gateCriterion: Before confirmation the user understands the executor, custody, KYC lane, fees and irreversibility; a dangerous action cannot be completed by an accidental tap.

changedSurfaces: focused Mini App UI regression tests

miniApp.reason: This is the only surface changed; it shows the existing buy, sell and TON wallet review before an external action.

publicSite.reason: The public edge serves the unchanged Mini App bytes for runtime verification only.

telegramBot.reason: The existing bot entry was health-checked; no handler, command or callback changed.

admin.reason: No operator surface or policy changed.

excluded: money API, quote, order, payout, wallet-signing or custody contract changes
database, migration, credential and service-unit changes
new execution authority or automatic action

behavior: A review acknowledgement is valid for at most two minutes; expiry clears its callback and disables confirmation until the form opens a new review.
The existing buy destination is retained in browser storage only after the user explicitly confirms and the existing create-order API returns success.

tests.command: /root/lumi/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_e4_exchange_review_ui.py tests/test_e4_miniapp_market_chart.py tests/test_e4_miniapp_browser_shell.py tests/test_e4_miniapp_mobile_secondary_navigation.py tests/test_e4_responsive_navigation.py tests/test_e4_bot_ecosystem_entry.py tests/test_e4_site_ecosystem_entry.py

staticChecks: All two inline Mini App script blocks compile with Node.js.
Gitleaks found no secrets in either changed file.

runtime.directLocalInterpretation: The direct unauthenticated FastAPI listener is not the public acceptance path; the canonical Nginx edge served the expected bytes and method boundary.

browserAutomation.reason: Playwright CLI was available, but Chromium exited because this root-host environment does not support Chromium sandboxing. No no-sandbox browser launch was used.

rollout.method: A root-owned preimage was captured first. A mode- and ownership-bound staging file was then renamed atomically over /opt/obsidian-exchange/relay/webapp.html. Relay reads this file on each /webapp GET, so no service restart was required.
rollout.rollback: Atomically replace the deployed file with the recorded root-only preimage, then repeat the public GET/POST and byte checks.

nextCanonicalItem: E4 / USABILITY_TEST_MONEY_PATHS: perform a bounded no-money usability validation of the current explicit-review flow on a supported non-root browser or Telegram device; the E4 gate remains open.
